subject: Manager-01 activated and initial swarm-readiness audit started
body: User explicitly designated this agent as a BenefitFlow manager and instructed it to begin work. Manager-01 verified the BenefitFlow repository boundary, read the live control/accepted state and beta baseline, added an additive MANAGER bootstrap, and opened an isolated manager artifactory workstream at BenefitFlow-AgentBus/artifactory/manager/manager-01/. Manager-01 will coordinate/decompose work, review and reconcile specialist evidence, identify contradictions and risks, and escalate recommendations to Primary without mutating Primary accepted state. The R&D gate is still treated as closed for specialist launch; manager-side swarm hardening and ten-agent assignment preparation are proceeding.
